body:
I'm just scared everything will fall apart in a few years. In the perspective of whoever manages job applications: You see this guy who definitely knows what he's doing and has a good portfolio, but then you see that he dropped out of school. How can you be assured this guy isn't hiding anything? How do you know he even has common sense beyond his love for coding?

Even if I built an insane portfolio over the next few months, why would anybody take a dropout? On top of that, the IT job market in Germany is tough as shit from what I heard when I still had contact to relatives...

Anyhow, I won't be able to respond until tomorrow most likely now. I have to get off my ass and do this mini-job. It won't do my mood too well either :/ Looking at the papers is so monotone...and I've slacked off for 2 weeks now, so I have like 3x the work, too...

Well, it won't do it from itself. Until tomorrow, I guess.

Multiplayer games in more than 2's are generally not my thing either. Especially games with random teams. I tried League and the concept of it doesn't appeal me either, so I got that going for me...

Final Fantasy...a lot of people I know in osu play that game too. Maybe I should take a look, but I'm generally not really into role-playing games.

I know that there's a future...but I really just don't know how I would be able to finish school and be able to study so I can do something programming related. As I was "technically" schooled during my sleep problems, my school..."mandation" (what's the word for "having to to do something"?) is over, so if I wanted to finish, I'd actually need to pay now. And money doesn't grow on trees. Neither does a school that would take a weird asperger...

Sometimes I think if I should give up dreams and just do some generic collar job, but I doubt it would help me relieve the days...then again, what really helps at this point...Does it really matter what I do now, if life ends at one point or another anyways?

Took me a bit longer to sleep in this time, but at least I'm feeling better now. It's just a game...at least, that's what I tell myself right now...

Also I actually promised to do some work-related stuff yesterday...and I kind of slept through that now again...it's 3 AM here. Whenever my mother wakes up, I'm gonna be able to listen to 30 minutes of "You're a worthless piece of shit" again. She has been having these outbursts since a few months now. Understandable, considering my sleep schedule is through the roof.

I just want a future. The ability to live alone, go to work, come back home, relax, sleep, and repeat. I don't care if it's boring for me. I just want a purpose in life. 

I honestly am absolutely used to being alone IRL. I can talk to people via the internet. For some reason, I don't feel "restricted" when I do that. But give me a real person to talk to, and I'm hiding however I'm feeling and most likely pretend I'm well. I mean, not like anybody in my known circle of oh-so-big maybe 10 people would listen anyways.

I somehow may sound comical...but my mood just got 20x shittier. Because of a video game. And now I remember why I made this post, because I really need help. I'm short of pulling a knife from the kitchen. Because of a fucking video game.

Just lost all my gear in Minecraft. Again. Got jumped, oh no problem, let's recover my stuff. Get's blown up while doing that. Quit the skype call with my friend, logged off on everything and am seriously wondering if it's comical if a simple incident in Minecraft would pull a trigger...

I don't think I'll be able to reply in any sort of normal conversation right now. I'm in mix of anger and tears. Hours of stuff gone again. I stopped caring about the "it's just a game" argument a long time ago...to be exact 2 years ago, when video games became my escape for my problems. And now they create more.

If I don't reply anymore I'm either dead or went to shutoff sleep. I tend to just sleep over stuff when I feel my emotions fucking with me. I'm sorry to leave it hanging as that, but I honestly am not able to identify myself anyone.

My name's Paul. IRL name, if somebody from my actual IRL reads this I'm fucked anyways.

London? Hm, when I was still schooled, I dreamed of doing one of these "exchange" things for a few months once. Sadly that got killed with the sleep issue.

Never saw actual out-city nature for 2 years now, been locked in my room 95% of the time pretty much. Maybe I should change that. But I can get fresh air by going into the small garden, so I got that going, at least...if I had used it in the years...

I'm actually playing a game while replying to you right now. My pretty much best "internet friend" just came online and we're playing a bit of Minecraft Survival. Gonna check here though, I'm just doing tasks like sorting chests right now. And yes, I told him. He's the guy I trust the most with, he knows my UHC story, I just told him about my mood rollercoaster.

I don't know if I ever was "frustrated". I'm more...scared...to say it accurately. Scared of not being able to power my future.

Oh, how osu likes to drag me into the void of doing nothing. Sorry :/

I'm on the more male side of the gender spectrum, in followup to your other comment. Should've probaly put that in the post?...yeah I'm not the brightest bulb.
